reason: My clients come from people who know me, fairs and calls I make myself. I already delete three or four agency pitches a week, so paying EUR 5,000 for at least three months to send more cold messages, with no meetings promised, feels like paying to become the thing I ignore.
objection: Do they really understand logistics? Buyers here pick a 3PL on trust and track record. A nicely researched email in Bulgarian from a domain nobody knows won't get a shipper to move freight to us, and if it goes badly it hurts my name in a small industry.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a logistics or 3PL firm like mine, ideally someone I can call, who got real meetings with shippers in the target country through them, plus a shorter paid trial without the 3-month lock-in.
